description: One piece of secondary information (a date, an owner, a count) with its icon, sized to sit under a title.

props.name: appearance
props.description: `meta` (default) = ambient text + dimmed icon (dates, counters). `eyebrow` = small fully-muted kicker label above a title. Absorbs the old <Eyebrow>.

example:
<Stack gap={2}>
  <MetaItem icon="description" appearance="eyebrow">Design sprint</MetaItem>
  <Row gap={3}>
    <MetaItem icon="schedule">Updated 2 days ago</MetaItem>
    <MetaItem icon="group">3 editors</MetaItem>
    <MetaItem icon="text_fields">1,240 words</MetaItem>
  </Row>
</Stack>
